Talk it through. Practise it. Then do it for real.

Rocky.ai is an AI coach that remembers you. Set a goal, think it through
in conversation, rehearse the exchange you've been dreading, and get
honest feedback on how you handled it — in a few minutes a day.

Launched in 2019, Rocky.ai was one of the first conversational AI coaching
apps, built on the science of positive psychology and solution-focused
coaching.

AI COACHING THAT ASKS, NOT TELLS

Most AI gives you advice. An AI coach asks the question that makes you
work it out yourself — and that's the difference between reading something
useful and actually changing. Your AI coach sets a goal with you,
remembers it, and follows up. Daily AI coaching for leadership,
communication, confidence, critical thinking, decision making and stress.

AI ROLEPLAY: PRACTISE THE CONVERSATION FIRST

Rehearse a salary negotiation, feedback you've been putting off, a job
interview, an angry client, a conversation at home you keep avoiding. In
an AI roleplay your counterpart stays in character, pushes back, and
reacts to what you actually say. Start from 40+ AI role play scenarios, or
describe your own real situation and practise exactly that.

Then it scores you. Every AI roleplay and coaching chat is assessed on
clarity, empathy, listening, and whether you actually agreed a next step.
Private, repeatable, and nobody watching.

WHAT ELSE YOU GET

- Interactive AI Courses — courses that talk back, with coaching chats,
roleplays and quizzes inside the lessons.

- Self-Assessments — short, science-based self-tests whose results carry
straight into your next AI coaching conversation.

- Progress & Development Plans — close the gap between where you are and
where you want to be, with goal setting, accountability and follow-ups.

- Voice & Talking Avatars — speak out loud and interrupt naturally, with
an AI coach who looks and sounds local.

- Memory & Follow-through — goals, nudges and check-ins, so what you
committed to on Monday is still alive on Thursday.

- Learning Library — curated material matched to your development plan.

- Multilingual Community — spaces and groups where every post appears in
your own language. 29 languages, right-to-left included.

Leaders who want to get better at the conversations that decide
everything. Salespeople who'd rather fail a pitch in private than in front
of a buyer. People who want stronger relationships — at work and at home.

quotes.text:
Especially in a time of corona pandemic and remote working, it is essential to stay motivated, to build confidence, and strengthen your professional skills for the time of the economic downturn.

Rocky is a self-improvement app that uses self-reflection with coaching questions and curated tips for your soft-skill portfolio.

Answer leadership coaching questions daily to structure and reflect on your day, for entrepreneurs and medium-sized company managers who are developing their careers.

* Meet your agenda
* Own your day
* Never fall off track.
* Take control over your direction in life
* Develop supporting habits and routines
* Boost your productivity and get things done
* Achieve and work towards your most important goals
* Build your career and work towards your promotion
* Master reflective thinking and become mindful about your behavior
* Gain clarity, get confident, learn and feel accomplished
* Create a happier, balanced and positive lifestyle

Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rocky-daily-journaling/id1492680249
Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.rocky.app

The app is free, the coaching is free to try for a month
